title: Whole Core Drill and Raised Inspection Yoke Preparation Corner
description: One newly authored empty industrial equipment-preparation corner scene, zero new independent models and one scene. The complete accepted bridge-grip twin-leg inspection-yoke exterior occupies the higher right terrace, keeping both entire articulated-looking legs and flat shoes, full bridge case, trigger, knee cheeks, complete relaxed cable and closed terminal. A single newly authored continuous three-level stepped plinth connects the two equipment seats through one narrow intermediate ledge, all above a separate finite common floor. Every original binary payload, local normal, opaque PBR dictionary and internal node transformation is preserved byte-for-byte; whole-unit wrappers translate only at exact binary-fraction offsets, without scaling, editing or extracting components. All three original ground soles lie on their full actual terrace faces, and the entire stepped plinth bottom rests on the common floor. Unlike the earlier raised-bag-closer/scale corner there is no two-pier shelf, rear boundary, weighing platform or tall beam; this is a low contiguous stepped display with two similarly high whole instruments. No workpiece, magnetic connection, power cable coupling, drilling or inspection workflow, joint motion, load, accuracy, defect detection, ergonomics, construction, manufacture or safety capability made or verified. No rigging animation physics or interaction.
